items.text: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
items.subject: General Updates

attachmentExcerpt.text: TO ALL STOCK EXCHANGES BSE LIMITED October 10, 2026 NATIONAL STOCK EXCHANGE OF INDIA LIMITED NEW YORK STOCK EXCHANGE Dear Sir/ Madam, Sub: Company statement on the U.S. Permanent Labor Certification Program Infosys Limited (“the Company”) is aware of the decision announced by the United States Department of Labor concerning the suspension of new and pending applications by certain companies, including Infosys, under the Permanent Labor Certification (“PERM”) program. We welcome the opportunity to work with the Department of Labor and related government agencies to answer any questions they may have. We do not anticipate yesterday's announcement of such suspension to have a material impact on the organization. The Company will make further disclosures, if required, in accordance with applicable regulatory standards. Infosys has invested in building a strong local workforce and technology and innovation hubs in the United States. The Company remains committed to its employees, clients, and communities across the United States and to complying with all applicable laws and regulations. Certain statements in this release, including those concerning the impact of the suspension of PERM applications are “forward looking statements” intended to qualify for the 'safe harbor' under the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995.
